title: 彭博策略师：市场低估人工智能资本开支**回报
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you think that there is a real question now to whether these tech giants can continue to spend in the way that they are when it comes to AI and data centers?
segments.zh: 现在是否真的存在一个问题：这些科技巨头能否继续像现在这样在AI和数据中心上投入？

segments.en: Is this the market trying to force them to pump the brakes? I mean, look, the market has been trying to force them.
segments.zh: 这是市场在试图迫使他们踩刹车吗？我的意思是，市场一直在试图这么做。

segments.en: I would say over the course of the last year or maybe two years and all that keeps happening is they keep upgrading those capex expectations.
segments.zh: 我想说，在过去一年或两年里，他们一直在上调资本支出预期。

segments.en: I think what the market is likely under appreciating, I think, are two things.
segments.zh: 我认为市场可能低估了两件事。

segments.en: So first of all, is that there is an ROI on a lot of the spend that's being rolled out.
segments.zh: 首先，很多支出是有**回报的。

segments.en: And the reason why you would spend $5, $600, $700 billion, I should say, into capex and data centers is because you're expecting to see your cloud revenues grow as a result
segments.zh: 之所以要投入5、6、7千亿美元到资本支出和数据中心，是因为你期望看到云收入随之增长。

segments.en: of that. We're seeing that certainly from the hyperscalers. We also see, as we've talked about last time, the hyperscaler cloud backlog of a trillion and a half.
segments.zh: 我们从超大规模云服务商那里看到了这一点。我们还看到，正如上次讨论的，他们的云积压订单高达1.5万亿美元。

segments.en: So all of those revenues are yet to be booked. So I do think that's one thing the markets are under appreciating.
segments.zh: 所有这些收入都尚未入账。所以我认为这是市场低估的一点。

segments.en: The other is, there was an interesting point this morning about Amazon and how AI enablement of Amazon can actually allow them to be better at placing ads, to be better at product recommendations.
segments.zh: 另一点是，今早有个有趣的观点：AI赋能亚马逊，可以使其更好地投放广告和推荐产品。

segments.en: And so, actually, the companies like some of those same hyperscalers are going to benefit in the other parts of their business, whether it's digital advertising, whether it's e-commerce,
segments.zh: 因此，这些超大规模云服务商的其他业务，如数字广告和电商，也将受益。

segments.en: whether it's social media, et cetera. So I think that's something that investors also should not lose sight of.
segments.zh: 无论是社交媒体等。所以我认为市场参与者也不应忽视这一点。

segments.en: Does it, though, just make life more difficult when they sell off like this?
segments.zh: 但这样抛售是否让情况更糟？
